limitations: The nine groups reproduce the proven deterministic centroid/bounds classification. Several tiny trim islands near group envelopes remain semantic judgments rather than provider-authored labels.

The archived retexture has 561 indexed islands rather than the untextured proof's 142; UV/material seam re-indexing is expected. Coincident-position welding still reproduces exactly 122 source components.

The archived retexture contains 12979 indexed triangles, compared with the earlier untextured proof's 12984. Blender imports 12979 of the retexture triangles and the semantic export retains every one of those imported faces/triangles.
This is a textured Mobile-base proof. The dominant carrier still owns the visible north armor surface, so Shell and Tower remain separate future add-on kits rather than body-lobe morphs.
PodPlant_HoverSettle proves four independent rigid pod clusters and reversible ground contact; it does not add telescoping piston geometry or authorize autonomous playback.
GunRecoil is a rigid rail translation into the existing carrier socket and still needs a final close-range clearance review.
No semantic team-accent material is authored in this stage. The provider PBR material and all source texture payloads are retained without tint ownership changes.
